title.quote: LANGEVIN SOFT ACTOR-CRITIC: EFFICIENT EXPLORATION THROUGH UNCERTAINTY-DRIVEN CRITIC LEARNING

analysis.description: The paper introduces Langevin Soft Actor-Critic (LSAC), a novel model-free RL algorithm tailored for continuous control tasks. The algorithm incorporates distributional Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) for efficient exploration and effective critic learning through uncertainty estimation rather than just policy optimization. LSAC shows improved performance by using multimodal Q-function posterior distribution and diffusion synthesized state-action samples, making it suitable for tasks like those in the MuJoCo and DMC suites.
